descriptions.aboutTagline: Real-time notes and summaries that never leave your machine.
descriptions.betaDisabledNote: When disabled, beta features will be hidden. Your existing meetings remain unaffected.
descriptions.betaImportAndRetranscribe: Import audio files to transcribe or retranscribe existing meetings with different language settings.
descriptions.betaMossPostMeetingEnhancement: Internal review flow for MOSS candidates. It is off by default and needs the P3 candidate storage and activation API.
descriptions.betaWarning: These features are still being tested. You may encounter issues, and we appreciate your feedback.
descriptions.comingSoon: A library of on-device AI agents—automating follow-ups, action tracking, and more.
descriptions.contactTeam: If you're planning to build privacy-first custom AI agents or a fully tailored product for your business, we can help you build it.
descriptions.costSmart: Avoid pay-per-minute bills by running models locally (or pay only for the calls you choose).
descriptions.privacyFirst: Your data and AI processing workflow can stay on your premises. No cloud, no leaks.
descriptions.showOrHideTheDeveloperConsoleWindowOnWin: Show or hide the developer console window. On Windows, this controls the console window. On macOS, this opens Terminal with app logs.
descriptions.useAnyModel: Prefer a local open-source model? Great. Want to plug in an external API? Also fine. No lock-in.
descriptions.worksEverywhere: Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams—online or offline.
descriptions.youNeedToFinishOnboardingBeforeYouCanSta: You need to finish onboarding before you can start recording.
